summary: Operator site + Campspot: open after Helene (no bath house, no tents), year round. Confirmed $40 primitive / $60 hillside / $65 riverside full hookup (Campspot Nov 2026 and June 2027 agree for the full-hookup types); changed hookups electric 0 -> 50 with water and sewer (the 0 described only the primitive sites); added max rig 45 ft, Campspot booking, no showers/toilets, Good Sam true (was false from the Good Sam directory), Passport America (restricted) and military. Note: AWH's price and Good Sam text moved to fields (awh_superseded), AWH's riverside primitive-site remark kept.
flags: Helene: reopened ('We Are Open For Camping!') but 'WE NO LONGER HAVE A BATH HOUSE, TREES, OR OFFER TENT CAMPING' (homepage, October 2026); the rates page still lists tent sites and a bathhouse code, so it is partly stale. Current pages still sell RV sites (Campspot: Hillside 3-5 and Riverside 6-10 full-hookup sites free on the dates tried).

AWH's $40 primitive RV sites: the operator's rates page still lists them ($40, sites 26 and 28), but Campspot's No Hookup Riverside type showed no bookable sites for 2026-11-10 or June 2027; they may be phone-only or out of service. Fees low kept at $40 from the operator's page.
Good Sam: the operator offers the Good Sam 10% discount, contradicting the derived good_sam false from the Good Sam directory (isGsPark false); written true from the operator's page.
Price gate: base $40 (primitive) / $60 (cheapest bookable full hookup); within 5 km of the Asheville gateway, so the gate is lifted. No trip references this entry.
